tools.description: Use before planning when support for requested document capabilities must be checked against the current Hancom 2020 target and caller permissions. This does not run the operation.
tools.name: capability_check
tools.title: Check document capability

tools.description: Use to compile a bounded natural-language document request into a validated immutable plan. This never changes a project, document, job, or artifact.
tools.name: document_plan
tools.title: Plan document operation

tools.description: Use to create a new immutable document revision from a previously validated plan, optionally with a template. This may start a job and never overwrites an existing revision.
tools.name: document_create
tools.title: Create document

tools.description: Use to inspect selected document structure, formatting, objects, package parts, or security facts. Full materialization may create a durable bounded snapshot, so it is not annotated read-only.
tools.name: document_inspect
tools.title: Inspect document

tools.description: Use to atomically apply a validated plan to one source revision with an exact revision precondition. The source remains immutable; success creates a new revision.
tools.name: document_edit
tools.title: Edit document revision

tools.description: Use for bounded merge, split, normalization, style mapping, or metadata sanitization across immutable source revisions. Always produces a preview diff and may run asynchronously.
tools.name: document_transform
tools.title: Transform document set

tools.description: Use to derive slots, immutable regions, preserve rules, and risky-control inventory from a template revision. Materializing the template contract may create an artifact.
tools.name: template_analyze
tools.title: Analyze document template

tools.description: Use to run explicitly selected package, semantic, Hancom 2020, render, accessibility, or security checks. Missing backends remain unverified and validation creates evidence/job state.
tools.name: document_validate
tools.title: Validate document revision

tools.description: Use to create bounded page previews or a PDF from a revision with renderer provenance. This creates a job or artifact and does not mutate the source revision.
tools.name: document_render
tools.title: Render document preview

tools.description: Use to export an immutable revision to one supported document format and generate a semantic-loss report. This only creates local artifacts and never uploads, emails, or prints them.
tools.name: document_export
tools.title: Export document

tools.description: Use to create a tenant-scoped document project with an explicit empty expected revision and replay-safe idempotency key.
tools.name: project_create
tools.title: Create document project

tools.description: Use to resume a project by reading its current head, warnings, conflicts, target, recent artifacts, or recommended next actions. This creates no state.
tools.name: project_open
tools.title: Open document project

tools.description: Use to page through the immutable revision graph and bounded semantic summaries between revisions. This creates no state.
tools.name: project_history
tools.title: Read project history

tools.description: Use to attach an immutable label to an exact project revision. Retries with the same idempotency key return the same checkpoint.
tools.name: project_checkpoint
tools.title: Checkpoint project revision

tools.description: Use to promote an exact revision to a local delivery label only after every requested validation gate passes. This does not transmit the artifact outside the service.
tools.name: project_publish
tools.title: Publish validated revision

tools.description: Use to read the current state, progress, result artifacts, and bounded event cursor of one asynchronous job. This creates no state.
tools.name: job_get
tools.title: Get document job

tools.description: Use to request safe cancellation of one queued or running job. Cancellation is best-effort, receipt-backed, idempotent, and potentially irreversible for that job.
tools.name: job_cancel
tools.title: Cancel document job

tools.description: Use after authorization to request bounded artifact metadata, preview delivery, or attachment delivery. Delivery data stays in MCP content or client-only metadata, not structured output.
tools.name: artifact_get
tools.title: Get artifact
